!For Petitioner : Mr.N.Sivakumar ^For R1 to R3 : Mr.M.Murugan  Government Advocate For R4 : Mr.M.Muniasamy For R5 :
Mr.S.Kiruba Vijay Anand :ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed by the petitioner to direct the third respondent to expedite the enquiry forwarded by the second respondent in O.Mu.No.3757/A6/12, dated 22.03.2012 and take action against the offenders in accordance with the provision of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.
2.

The case of the petitioner is that he purchased the alcoholic drink quarter bottle of Sipping Spirits Resolute Pink Vodaka from the retail Vendor of the fourth respondent in their Shop No.4859 at Puliyoor Kurichi, Kanyakumari District, for his personal consumption.
At that time, he found some insects and black colour dusts inside the bottle.
Therefore, he did not open the bottle and made an oral complaint to the servants of the fourth respondent and the same was reported to the fourth respondent.

The fourth respondent by his proceedings in Na.Ka.No.133/E/12, dated 27.01.2012,
called upon the petitioner to find out the genuineness of the complaint.
The petitioner approached the fourth respondent along with his counsel and the fourth respondent inspected the said bottle.
Thereafter, no action was taken against the fifth respondent.
The fifth respondent also sent a reply to the notice sent by the petitioner denying all the allegations.
Thereafter, the petitioner's counsel sent a legal notice to the Revenue Officials and to the Director of Health Services, who is the second respondent herein.
The second respondent forwarded the legal notice to the third respondent, who is competent authority for taking further action.
The third respondent has not taken any action so far.

Therefore, the petitioner has filed the present writ petition for the relief stated supra.
3. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

4. Though the writ petition is filed for seeking issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, directing the third respondent to expedite the enquiry forwarded by the second respondent in O.Mu.No.3757/A6/2012,
dated 22.03.2012 and take action against the offenders in accordance with the provision of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner in the course of his argument, submitted that liberty may be given to the petitioner to send a complaint to the third respondent.
